## Assesses network quality with EGAD.
##   - Neighbour-voting AUROC: how well the network recovers GO term membership.
##   - Degree-null AUROC: performance from node degree alone (how much hub genes drive the result).
##   - Multifunctionality AUROC: performance from annotation counts alone (how much heavily annotated genes drive the result).
## Complex recovery (proteasome, RNA polymerase II, CCT, MCM2-7 and V-ATPase) is assessed by:
##   - Per-gene AUROC: complex genes vs. all other genes, ranked by edge weight.
##   - Pair-level auPRC: within-complex gene pairs (positives) vs. pairs between different complexes,
##     ranked by edge weight 
---
title: "EGAD"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-08"
---

```{r}
library(EGAD)
library (ROCR)
```


# read the TOM and the propagated GO
```{r}
go <- as.data.frame(readr::read_delim("asper_computed_propagated.tsv", delim = "\t"))
network <- readRDS("asper_pearson.rds")
```


# make the labels for EGAD
```{r}
labels <- make_annotations(go[, 1:2],          # genes in column 1, terms in column 2
                           rownames(network),  # rows: every network gene, in network order
                           unique(go[[2]]))    # columns: every GO term
nrow(labels) == nrow(network)    
sum(labels) > 0                 
# the GO terms that are tested for multi analysis
labels_f <- filter_network_cols(labels, min = 20, max = 300)
ncol(labels_f)                   # GO terms tested
```


# run neighbour voting on the real network
```{r}
set.seed(1)
neigh <- run_GBA(network, labels, min = 20, max = 300, nfold = 3)
# neigh: [[1]] per-term table, [[2]] predictions, [[3]] mean AUROC

network_nv_auroc          <- neigh[[3]]                                          # mean neighbour-voting AUROC
network_degree_null_auroc <- mean(neigh[[1]][, "degree_null_auc"], na.rm = TRUE) # hub control

network_nv_auroc
network_degree_null_auroc
nrow(neigh[[1]])                                                                 # GO terms tested
```


# multifunctionality (a property of the annotations, the same for every network)
```{r}
multi     <- calculate_multifunc(labels_f)
multi_auc <- auc_multifunc(labels_f, as.numeric(multi[, 4]))   # column 4 = multifunctionality rank

multifunc_auroc <- mean(multi_auc, na.rm = TRUE)
multifunc_auroc
```


# random: shuffled-label baseline
```{r}
set.seed(1)

# a random order of the row numbers
new_order <- sample(nrow(labels_f))

# reorder the rows: each gene's whole set of GO terms moves together
labels_shuf <- labels_f[new_order, , drop = FALSE]

# put the gene IDs back in their original order,
# so each gene now carries another gene's GO terms
rownames(labels_shuf) <- rownames(labels_f)

# run neighbour voting on the shuffled labels- dont need the predictions so just run neighbhour_voting
res <- neighbor_voting(labels_shuf, network, nFold = 3, output = "AUROC")
# res: one row per GO term, columns "auc", "avg_node_degree", "degree_null_auc"

random_nv_auroc          <- mean(res[, "auc"], na.rm = TRUE)
random_degree_null_auroc <- mean(res[, "degree_null_auc"], na.rm = TRUE)

random_nv_auroc
random_degree_null_auroc
```


# results: network vs random
```{r}
results <- data.frame(
  metric = c("Neighbour-voting AUROC",
             "Degree-null AUROC",
             "Multifunctionality AUROC"),
  network = c(network_nv_auroc,
              network_degree_null_auroc,
              multifunc_auroc),
  # multifunctionality depends only on the annotations, and shuffling whole rows
  # does not change it, so it has no separate random value
  random = c(random_nv_auroc,
             random_degree_null_auroc,
             NA)
)

results

write.table(results, "egad_results_asper_pearson.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```
# Complex analysis 

# AUROC
```{r}
library(EGAD)
library (ROCR)

network <- readRDS("asper_pearson.rds")
complex <- as.data.frame(readr::read_delim("asper_gene_complex.tsv", delim = "\t"))
# filter out complex genes that aren't in the network
complex   <- complex[complex$Gene %in% rownames(network), ]
# get number of genes assigned to a complex
nrow(complex)

# run auroc
per_gene_auroc <- function(network, cx) {
  auc <- c()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(cx))) { # for every complex gene
    gene     <- cx$Gene[i]
    partners <- cx$Gene[cx$Complex == cx$Complex[i] & cx$Gene != gene] #get its partners
    others   <- setdiff(rownames(network), gene) #get all genes that arent the goi
    scores   <- network[gene, others] #get the edge weights for every gene
    labels   <- as.integer(others %in% partners) # true false for partner relationships
    pred     <- prediction(scores, labels) #rocr function to pair scores with label
    auc[i]   <- performance(pred, "auc")@y.values[[1]] #acccess the values
  }
  auc #return
}

# run on network 
gene_auc <- per_gene_auroc(network, complex)
complex$AUROC <- gene_auc
network_auroc <- mean(gene_auc)
network_auroc

# check for each complex (one complex might consistently peform poorly)
per_complex <- tapply(complex$AUROC, complex$Complex, mean)
per_gene <- complex[order(complex$Complex, complex$AUROC), ] 

print(per_gene) 


```

# run precision-recall
```{r}
pairs <- as.data.frame(readr::read_delim("asper_complex_pairs.tsv", delim = "\t"))
# filter out pairs that arent in the network
pairs <- pairs[pairs$Gene1 %in% rownames(network) & pairs$Gene2 %in% rownames(network), ]
# get number of genes assigned to a complex
nrow(pairs)

# run pr using rocr
pair_pr <- function(network, pairs) {
  scores <- network[cbind(pairs$Gene1, pairs$Gene2)] #get the scores for both
  pred   <- prediction(scores, pairs$Label) #pair scores with label
  auprc  <- performance(pred, "aucpr")@y.values[[1]] #run aupcr
  prior  <- mean(pairs$Label) # divide by the proportion of positives/all pairs available - make it comparable between organisms
  log2(auprc / prior) # long transform 
}

network_pr    <- pair_pr(network, pairs)
network_pr
```

# run on random network 
```{r}
set.seed(1)
n_shuffles   <- 10
random_auroc <- c()
random_pr    <- c()

for (r in 1:n_shuffles) {
  # each network gene gets another gene's ID but retains the information in correct order
  new_id <- setNames(sample(rownames(network)), rownames(network))

  cx_shuf       <- complex
  cx_shuf$Gene  <- new_id[complex$Gene] #apply the new shuffle

  pairs_shuf       <- pairs
  pairs_shuf$Gene1 <- new_id[pairs$Gene1] #apply to the pairs
  pairs_shuf$Gene2 <- new_id[pairs$Gene2]

  random_auroc[r] <- mean(per_gene_auroc(network, cx_shuf))  #run
  random_pr[r]    <- pair_pr(network, pairs_shuf) #run 
}
```

# table

```{r}
# results table
complex_results <- data.frame(
  metric      = c("Per-gene AUROC (mean)", "Pair PR log2(auPRC/prior)"),
  network     = c(network_auroc, network_pr),
  random_mean = c(mean(random_auroc), mean(random_pr)),
  random_sd   = c(sd(random_auroc), sd(random_pr))
)
complex_results

write.table(complex_results, "complex_results_asper_pearson.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
per_complex_df <- data.frame(Complex = names(per_complex), AUROC = as.numeric(per_complex))
write.table(per_complex_df, "per_complex_results_asper_pearson.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)


```
